name: Club Brumidi
description: Dance nights at the Sons of Italy lodge in Deer Park, including a weekly Wednesday ballroom and Latin social with DJ and buffet.
reviewNotes:
Club Brumidi is the lodge's own dance-night name, not a separate group. Wednesday-social table reservations: (516) 991-3208.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Club Brumidi is the lodge's own name for its dance nights, so the website, phone, email and Facebook are the lodge's (same as the brumidi-lodge venue). Logo is the national Order Sons and Daughters of Italy in America emblem that the lodge uses in its site header (290x300). Only one photo used (building front); the lodge gallery is mostly posed member/holiday group photos, several with children, and none clearly show dancing. The Wednesday-social table reservation line (516) 991-3208 is published under a first name on the lodge's event page; not recorded as the main phone. No opening hours published; Instagram not found.

evidence.note: Lodge contact page: Constantino Brumidi Lodge #2211, 2075 Deer Park Avenue, Deer Park, NY 11729; lodge office 631-940-2006; lodge@sonsofitalyli.com; links the Brumidilodge Facebook page.
Lodge's own event page: every Wednesday 6-10 PM 'at Club Brumidi', social dance mix with DJ Gene, free lesson on the 1st Wednesday, buffet, $25; full-table reservations (516) 991-3208.
Events list uses 'Club Brumidi' as the name of the lodge's dance nights (Wednesday social, Friday dances).
